company.name: PrismML
company.shortDescription: PrismML develops foundation models to deliver advanced AI capabilities with significantly lower memory, compute, and energy requirements.
company.description:
PrismML is an artificial intelligence infrastructure company that develops ultra-efficient foundation models designed to deliver advanced AI capabilities with significantly lower memory, compute, and energy requirements. The company focuses on enabling powerful AI to run efficiently on edge devices such as smartphones, laptops, embedded systems, and other resource-constrained hardware, while also reducing the cost and energy demands of cloud AI infrastructure.

The company's flagship Bonsai family of models includes the industry's first commercially viable 1-bit and 1.58-bit (ternary) large language models, which dramatically reduce model size while maintaining competitive reasoning and language capabilities. Unlike traditional 16-bit models, PrismML's native low-bit architectures are designed from the ground up to minimize memory footprint and inference costs, making advanced AI practical for on-device applications and energy-efficient cloud deployments. The company has also introduced Bonsai Image, a family of compressed diffusion models that enables high-quality image generation on local devices. In addition to model development, PrismML provides open-source models, developer tools, and research that enable AI applications across consumer devices, enterprise systems, and embedded hardware. Its technology is built on proprietary mathematical research developed at Caltech and is intended to support a new generation of AI hardware and software optimized for efficient inference. The company's models are compatible with existing AI workflows while requiring substantially less memory and energy than conventional architectures.
